versions.changelog: Video and multi-megabyte images are publishable again — the old ~1MB ceiling is gone.
Agents now prompt for the workspace publishing rules when none are saved yet, and point at the console panel where they are set.
Agents now read and follow the workspace publishing profile (brand voice and per-platform rules) returned by the accounts call.
Version handshake with the API plus a user-triggered update command, and documents the current ~1MB per-file media limit (video goes through managed publishing for now).
Clarify first-party authorization context; instruct agents to hand the confirm command to the user instead of abandoning the flow.
Initial release: draft→confirm publishing to IG/TikTok/FB/YouTube/LinkedIn/Threads/Google/Telegram via InstallMyClaw workspace; media upload; scheduling; per-platform status.
